title: Bag Of Tokens
description:
You are given an integer array `tokens` and an integer `power`. You start with score `0`. Each token may be played at most once: play a token face-up by spending its value in power and gaining one score, or face-down by spending one score and gaining its value in power. Return the maximum score possible.

## Examples

```text
Input: tokens = [100, 200, 300, 400], power = 200
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: tokens = [100], power = 50
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `0 <= tokens.length <= 1000`
- `0 <= tokens[i], power < 10^4`
